title: Recruitment System
description: Modern responsive frontend for an Recruitment System (built with FastAPI backend).
longDescription: Developed the complete frontend (UI/UX) for Recruitment System – a recruitment system for private company. The platform allows companies to manage their recruitment processes (Job postings, applications, interviews scheduling). Built a clean, modern, and highly responsive interface using ReactJs NextJs, and Tailwind CSS focused on clarity, compliance transparency, and smooth user experience for Hr/Managers, amd applicants.

title: AI Interview Platform
description: Full-stack AI-powered platform for mock interviews, real interviews, resume tools, and career counseling.
longDescription: A complete full-stack platform for AI-powered mock interviews and real interview simulations. Features include a resume builder, resume improvement tool, career counseling chatbot, and role-based access control for companies and candidates. Built both frontend and backend with real-time AI integration using Next.js, Prisma, Firebase, Gemini API, and Ollama LLM.

title: Sow Agent
description: A teach new scrapping agent build using Next.js, n8n workflow to automate the process of scrapping news from different sources.
longDescription: Developed the complete frontend for Neoflux AI (Sow Agent), a modern curated news platform. The platform provides users with a personalized daily digest from trusted global sources. Built the responsive user interface, secure authentication flow, and interactive dashboard using Vite.js, focusing on clean design and an optimized user experience across all devices.

title: Easy School - K12 School Management System
description: A comprehensive K-12 school management system built with ReactJs and NestJS, designed to streamline administrative tasks and enhance productivity and performance of schools, teachers, and students,and also keep parents informed about their student performance and attandence.
longDescription: Easy School is a comprehensive K-12 school management system built with ReactJs and NestJS, designed to streamline administrative tasks and enhance productivity and performance of schools, teachers, and students,and also keep parents informed about their student performance and attandence. Intergrated with Stripe for fee payments and LLM to seemlessly analyze student performance by (automated test checking) and enhance productivity by allowing teacher to generate questions (mcqs) using LLM also.

title: Myshow AI - video generation platform
description: Create stunning AI-generated videos with subtitles in seconds.
longDescription: Myshow AI is a video generation platform that allows users to generate videos from text, images, and audio. It uses AI LLM to generate videos (Wan AI) from text, images (Nano Banana), and audio (Elevenlabs).

title: Alfa Core Education - School Management System
description: A comprehensive school management system built with ReactJs and NestJS, designed to streamline administrative tasks and enhance productivity and performance of schools, teachers, and students,and also keep parents informed about their student performance and attandence.
longDescription: Alfa core education is a comprehensive K-12 school management system built with ReactJs and NestJS, designed to streamline administrative tasks and enhance productivity and performance of schools, teachers, and students,and also keep parents informed about their student performance and attandence. Intergrated with Stripe for fee payments and LLM to seemlessly analyze student performance by (automated test and Homework checking) and increase productivity by allowing teacher to generate questions (mcqs) using LLM also.

title: Shovel House
description: A social enterprise platform connecting homeowners with local helpers for snow shoveling, lawn mowing, and leaf raking.
longDescription: Developed the frontend Progressive Web App (PWA) for Shovel House, a social enterprise platform that connects homeowners with local helpers for tasks like snow shoveling, lawn mowing, and leaf raking. Built a responsive and accessible user interface using React.js and modern web technologies to ensure a seamless experience for both homeowners and helpers across all devices.

title: Ezly - WebApp + webExtension
description: An AI communication assistant and Chrome extension that generates context-aware replies and proposals for freelancers on platforms like Upwork and fiver.
longDescription: Contributed frontend, backend and web extension for Ezly in early stage, an AI-powered communication tool for freelancers. The project consists of a web dashboard for managing AI personas and knowledge bases, alongside a Chrome extension that integrates natively into Upwork, Fiverr, LinkedIn, Gmail, and Discord. Focused on building a seamless, high-performance UI to generate instant contextual replies and tailored proposals, helping professionals close deals faster.

title: Designrift - Theme Generator
description: An open-source theme builder for creating custom Shadcn and Radix UI themes with WCAG contrast, dark mode, and Tailwind support.
longDescription: Contributed to Designrift, an open-source theme generator that allows developers to design stunning, accessible themes using Radix colors. Features include full Tailwind v4 & v3 compatibility, precise color and font adjustments, built-in contrast evaluator for accessibility, and one-click export to CSS variables or Tailwind config. Built as a full-stack Next.js application to seamlessly integrate custom themes into modern React projects.

title: AI Chatbot Starter Template
description: A full-featured, open-source Next.js AI chatbot template powered by the Vercel AI SDK.
longDescription: Contributed to an open-source AI chatbot template built with Next.js App Router and the Vercel AI SDK. Features include support for multiple LLM providers (xAI, OpenAI), dynamic generative UI components with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS, data persistence using Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob, and secure authentication via Auth.js.

title: Bloggen - SaaS Starter Template
description: A high-performance Next.js starter template for building SEO-optimized, content-rich SaaS applications.
longDescription: Contributed to a Next.js SaaS starter template within the Bloggen ecosystem, designed to build SEO-optimized and structured content-driven applications. Built using MDX (Fumadocs), Tailwind CSS v4, and modern strict-mode React. Includes advanced global metadata configuration, type-safe environment variables via Zod, dynamic Open Graph image generation, and robust developer tooling.

title: Bloggen - Auth Starter Template
description: A robust Next.js authentication starter template tailored for SEO-optimized content websites.
longDescription: contributed to an authentication-focused Next.js starter template for the Bloggen ecosystem. Provides secure authentication flows fully integrated with an MDX-powered architecture, enabling developers to quickly build and deploy content-rich websites with protected routes, dynamic pages, and a fully typed comprehensive global SEO system.

title: Mother Box - Wedding Guest Management
description: A sophisticated guest management and reservation system for weddings, featuring RSVP tracking and event organization.
longDescription: Developed the frontend for Mother Box, a comprehensive guest management and reservation platform specifically designed for weddings and large events. The system enables users to efficiently manage guest lists, track real-time RSVP statuses, and handle event-specific reservations. Built using Next.js, TypeScript, and Shadcn UI, the application provides a modern, intuitive, and responsive experience for both event organizers and guests.

title: Rinor OTA - Online Travel Agency
description: A full-stack online travel agency platform for browsing and booking hotels, tours, restaurants, vehicles, and train tickets.
longDescription: Built Rinor OTA, a comprehensive online travel agency platform. Developed interactive listing and reservation pages for hotels, tours, restaurants, vehicles, trains, and special activities using React.js with Material UI and Tailwind CSS. Implemented an admin dashboard featuring user management, employee payroll with salary calculations, financial health tracking with Recharts visualizations, and refund request handling. Integrated React-Leaflet for interactive maps and jsPDF for report generation.

title: Rinor DMC - Destination Management Company
description: A comprehensive Destination Management Company platform for managing travel listings, including accommodations, destinations, and transportation.
longDescription: Developed a full-stack Destination Management Company (DMC) platform for Rinor. The application facilitates the management and listing of various travel services such as accommodations, tourist destinations, and transportation options. Built with a React frontend and a Node.js/Express backend, it features a robust dashboard for overviewing operations, integrated authentication, and internationalization (i18n) support. The system uses a centralized Redux store for state management and Material UI for a professional, responsive interface.

title: WareHouse Management System
description: A comprehensive warehouse management system for managing inventory, orders, and shipments.
longDescription: Developed a full-stack warehouse management system for managing inventory, orders, and shipments. Built with a React frontend and a Node.js/Express backend, it features a robust dashboard for overviewing operations, integrated authentication. The system uses a centralized Redux store for state management and Material UI for a professional, responsive interface.

title: Avicena Healthcare
description: A modern web portal built for Avicena Healthcare to provide accessible healthcare services.
longDescription: Contributed to the frontend interface, logics and backend services for Avicena Healthcare using React, MUI and Tailwind CSS. The platform serves as a modern digital gateway for the healthcare provider, focusing on accessibility, responsive design, and providing clear information for patients and stakeholders.

title: Piazza APIs - A RESTful API for Piazza
description: A robust backend API for managing user authentication (OAuth2), post creation, reactions, and comments.
longDescription: This project implements a backend API designed to provide server-side functionality for a social media platform Piazza similar to twitter. It features secure routes for managing user authentication (OAuth2), post creation, reactions (likes/dislikes), and adding comments, built using Node.js and RESTful architecture.
